description: Prefill the Progress Bar Animation Maker: a progress or loading bar that fills over any time, on a green screen you can key out. Returns a link that opens the Tool with these options; the user presses Export there to download the video. All options are optional. Icons, images and audio that need a file upload are not supported.

corners.description: Rounded or square ends of the bar. Default: "rounded".

ease.description: How the fill speeds up and slows down. Default: "linear".

end.description: Percent the bar fills to, a whole number from 0 to 100. Below the start it drains. Default: 100.

fill.description: Color of the filled part of the bar. Default: "#ffffff".

font.description: Font id of the label and the percentage. Default: "inter".

hold.description: Seconds the final percent holds at the end. Default: 1.

label.description: The label text, one line. Default: "Loading...".

lbl.description: Show the label above the bar, on the left: 1 on, 0 off. Default: true.

pct.description: Show the percentage above the bar, on the right: 1 on, 0 off. Default: true.

start.description: Percent the bar is filled to at the start, a whole number from 0 to 100. Default: 0.

text.description: Color of the label and the percentage. Default: "#ffffff".

thick.description: How tall the bar is. Default: "regular".

track.description: Color of the empty track behind the fill, drawn see-through. Default: "#ffffff".

name: create_progress_bar_animation
title: Progress Bar Animation Maker
